name: Official Jev resources
blurb: TypeSafe-owned SDKs, skills and reference material
description: The small set of repositories published by TypeSafe AI. Start here when you want the documented interface rather than a third-party integration.

name: SDKs and clients
blurb: Call Jev from Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust and more
description: Client libraries that wrap the Jev API. Useful when you want typed decisions in your own service instead of adopting a full framework.

name: Browser agents
blurb: Drive Chrome, Playwright or a real page
description: Agents that read a page and choose an action. Jev selects the operation and target while the surrounding code executes and verifies it.

name: Local alternatives to Jev
blurb: Run decision models on your own hardware
description: Independent models and shims that follow the System One interface. They can replace hosted Jev for some workloads; they are not TypeSafe products.

name: Research and benchmarks
description: Benchmarks, papers and independent reproductions. Read these when you need to understand behaviour rather than adopt a library.

name: Coding agents and review
blurb: Gate edits, diffs and tool calls
description: Coding assistants and review tools that use Jev to choose the next step or judge a change before it lands.

name: Trading and finance
description: Trading bots, research desks and portfolio tools with a typed decision step. Treat performance claims as unverified.

name: RAG and retrieval
blurb: Ground answers in your own data
description: Retrieval, memory and knowledge-base projects with an optional Jev scoring or filtering step.

name: Games and simulations
blurb: Policies and judges for game agents
description: Games and sandboxes where Jev chooses a move, evaluates an outcome or judges generated content.

name: Demos and playgrounds
description: Small projects that show one Jev primitive with the least amount of code. Good for a first run.

name: Agent tooling
description: Frameworks, routers and utilities that use Jev to choose tools or branches inside a larger agent system.

name: Applications
description: Complete applications where Jev makes a product decision: routing, ranking, classification or approval.
